name: claude-rigor
description: Skills that support a scientific research workflow in Claude Code: auditing a project for reproducibility and honest reporting, and recovering your own understanding of it.

plugins.name: research
plugins.description: Three skills for research projects: /research:onboard installs the research standard into a project and settles its conventions; /research:science-audit checks a project for reproducibility, provenance and honest reporting; /research:tutor helps you re-understand a project you built with heavy assistance.
